text:
marta: Hey — bringing up a HF->Redwood conversion for a new chat model and hitting weird truncation + repeated end tokens. Logs show shard/index mismatch. Anyone seen this after a revision bump? :thinking:

linus: @marta can you paste the convert command and the index.json you saw? might be a revision/caching issue.

marta: command I ran:
```
python convert_to_redwood.py --model-id org/llamaish/special-chat --output ./converted --revision v2 --format safetensors
```
index.json excerpt I pulled from the hub after the run:
{"weights": ["pytorch_model-00001-of-00002.safetensors", "pytorch_model-00002-of-00002.safetensors"], "shard_count": 3}
conversion log: "ValueError: shard count mismatch: expected 3, found 2" and later runtime maps wrong weight->shard. tokenizer dropped special tokens so generation truncates early.

raj: yep. saw something similar. HF hub client can return a cached index.json for repo+revision; if upstream did a non-atomic upload (index.json updated before shards finished uploading) the index refers to files that aren't present yet. also if convert-tool pins a revision but the local cache has a stale commit, you get mismatch. :facepalm: 

sophia: I reproduced locally with a small test:
1) rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface/hub
2) push an index.json that references 3 shards, only upload 2 (simulate network partial)
3) run convert with --revision v2
Result: ValueError shard mismatch and tokenizer.json loses eos/pad entries.

ci-bot: Created issue: https://github.com/redwood/convertor/issues/456 — title: "hf-hub: handle non-atomic safetensors uploads + index.json mismatch"

linus: temporary/workaround notes: pass `--download-atomic` to the converter (it will verify listed files exist before proceeding), or set env vars to avoid reuse of stale cache: `export HF_HOME=/tmp/hf_home_test && rm -rf $HF_HOME` before convert. Also double-check model config.json for missing special tokens (e.g., "eos_token_id"). Missing token ids cause truncation even when weights map is fine.

marta: stack trace snippet:
```
File "convert.py", line 421, in map_weight_to_shard
  shard_idx = index["weight_map"][weight_key]
KeyError: 'transformer.wte.weight'
```
and tokenizer.json showed "added_tokens": [] where it should have "added_tokens": [{"id":50256, "content":"\\u0120"}] (example).

raj: proposed fix in my head: converter should download index.json then validate that every filename in index exists in the repo for that commit (or retry until timeout). If mismatch -> clear hub cache for that repo+revision or fail with actionable message listing missing files and suggesting `rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface/hub`. Also switch hub download to use commit SHA (etag) where possible instead of loose revision names. I'll draft a PR.

sophia: test idea: add an integration test that simulates partial uploads (index lists N shards, only upload N-1) and verify converter fails with a helpful error and doesn't produce a corrupted converted model. I'll add tests/hf_integration/test_missing_shards.py in the PR.

marta: Thanks all — re-uploading with atomic pattern (upload shards first, then index.json last) as mitigation. @linus please watch the PR. :thumbsup:
